scientific_integrity: The endpoint proof is analytic; numerical code is corroborative and is not an infinite proof. Earlier scalar maximization and hyperbolic stationarity are credited.
scientific_limitations: Endpoint asymptotics rely on the established exact planar numerical-index formula (arXiv:2606.01675v1). Unindexed equivalent asymptotics remain a priority risk. No finite-exponent closed form or higher-dimensional statement is claimed.
title: Sharp logarithmic endpoint law for the numerical index of real \(\ell_p^2\)
